metadata.title: Genome-wide identification of the auxin transporter gene families in sweet potato (Ipomoea batatas) and their expression during tuberization

entities.name: IbLAX1
entities.description: Auxin influx carrier gene in sweet potato; up-regulated during tuber initiation and highly expressed in several tissues.

entities.name: IbPIN13
entities.description: PIN family gene in sweet potato; a canonical PIN auxin efflux protein and up-regulated during storage root initiation.

entities.name: IbPILS7
entities.description: PILS family gene in sweet potato; up-regulated during tuber initiation and implicated in intercellular auxin partitioning.

entities.name: IbABCB1
entities.description: ABCB family gene in sweet potato; predicted to be an auxin transporter and up-regulated during storage root initiation.

entities.name: IbABCB14
entities.description: ABCB family gene in sweet potato; predicted to be an auxin transporter and up-regulated during storage root initiation.

entities.name: storage root initiation
entities.description: Initiation of sweet potato storage root/tuber development.

relations.mechanism: IbLAX1 is an auxin influx carrier and was up-regulated during storage root/tuber initiation, suggesting it contributes to initiation.
relations.evidence: IbLAX1 was up-regulated in SRs vs. FRs at tuber initiation (30 DAT), and the significant up-regulation during SR indicates that IbLAX1 ... [is a] strong candidate[] for further in-depth studies on [its] functions during SR initiation.

relations.mechanism: IbPIN13 is a canonical PIN auxin efflux protein and was up-regulated during storage root initiation and as initiation progressed.
relations.evidence: IbPIN13 was up-regulated in SRs vs. FRs at tuber initiation (30 DAT) ... IbPIN13 is a canonical PIN auxin efflux protein that is up-regulated in SRs vs FRs and also up-regulated as SR initiation progresses.

relations.mechanism: IbPILS7 was up-regulated during storage root initiation and may have a role in intercellular auxin partitioning.
relations.evidence: IbPILS7 was up-regulated in SRs vs. FRs at tuber initiation (30 DAT) ... IbPILS7 is also up-regulated at SR initiation, and since PILS proteins are involved in intercellular auxin partitioning, it is possible that IbPILS7 has a similar role.

relations.mechanism: IbABCB1 was up-regulated during storage root initiation and was predicted to be an auxin transporter.
relations.evidence: Two of the three up-regulated IbABCB genes (IbABCB1 and IbABCB14) were predicted to be auxin transporters ... The up-regulation of IbABCB1 in SRs vs. FRs at 40 DAT and 50 DAT ... supports its role in SR development.

relations.mechanism: IbABCB14 was up-regulated during storage root initiation and was predicted to be an auxin transporter.
relations.evidence: Two of the three up-regulated IbABCB genes (IbABCB1 and IbABCB14) were predicted to be auxin transporters ... and ... is also up-regulated during SR initiation and development and is also predicted to be an auxin transporter.
